Gorilla_Heavy_Jaws.description: Enveloped in a gnarled visage of brute power, the Gorilla_Heavy_Jaws component transforms its bearer into a living siege weapon, with a maw that could cleave through steel and a jaw strength capable of crushing bones, while its thickened skull offers a measure of natural protection against the rigors of battle.

Baboon_Fierce_Fanged_Maw.description: Enveloped in a cloak of primal ferocity, the Baboon_Fierce_Fanged_Maw is a formidable cephalon with an elongated, powerful jaw lined with razor-sharp fangs capable of delivering swift, devastating bites that leave enemies reeling from both the physical impact and a lingering, debilitating bleed effect.

Mandrill_Colorful_Snarling_Jaw.description: The Mandrill_Colorful_Snarling_Jaw is a fearsome cephalon with a vibrant, venomous bite, its jaw a grotesque blend of charisma and raw power, capable of terrifying foes and charming the unwary with its paradoxical allure.

Chimpanzee_Nimble_Lips_Maw.description: This entity, a fearsome primate cephalon, possesses a dexterous maw that grants it unparalleled agility and strength, allowing it to execute swift, precise maneuvers and unleash devastating bites with remarkable ease.

Vampire_Bat_Monkey_Fangs.description: With razor-sharp fangs forged in the dark cauldron of a primordial swamp, these vampire bat monkey fangs grant an unnatural agility and the ability to deliver toxic bites that sicken and bleed prey over time, turning every snap and jab into a deadly dance of poison and pain.

Zombie_Ape_Gore_Stained_Maw.description: The Zombie_Ape_Gore_Stained_Maw is a grotesque cephalon, its rotting primate skull twisted with unholy magic, teeth jagged and dripping with the venomous ichor of countless victims, enhancing its strength and malevolent cunning while it spews a toxic cloud from its diseased maw.

Spectral_Ape_Howling_Maw.description: The Spectral Ape Howling Maw is a macabre cephalon with a cavernous mouth that seems to echo the cries of the forsaken, its ethereal form humming with sonic magic that can shake the resolve of even the most stalwart foes, while its eerie presence grants a chilling wisdom and charisma that borders on the malevolent.

Howler_Monkey_Resonating_Jaw.description: Equipped with a resonating jaw, this Howler Monkey's Cephalon emits hauntingly melodic cries that can both charm and intimidate foes, while its powerful bite delivers a devastating strike.

Lemur_Small_Nibbling_Teeth.description: These tiny, razor-sharp teeth are ensconced in a nimble jaw, perfectly adapted for rapid, precise bites that belie their small size, enhancing the agility of their primate host while granting them a deadly, swift bite.

Orangutan_Thick_Lipped_Maw.description: This creature's massive, thick-lipped maw is a testament to its brute strength and cunning, with rows of razor-sharp teeth capable of delivering a bone-crushing bite, while also hinting at an unexpected depth of wisdom and resilience.
